---
title: "Generalized Linear Models Homework Solutions"
---

This website contains detailed solutions for the Generalized Linear Models (GLM) course assignments.

## Contents

- [**Contingency Table**](ContingencyTable/001_answer.md): Basic analysis of contingency tables, Odds Ratios, Relative Risk, and Chi-square tests.
- [**Logistic Regression**](LogisticRegression/001_answer.md): Binary response models, Logit link, Interpretation of coefficients, and Model selection.
- [**Log-Linear Model**](LogLinearModel/001_answer.md): Count data analysis, Poisson regression, Independence models, and Collapsibility.

## Note

The solutions include:
- **Mathematical Derivations**: Rigorous proofs and step-by-step calculations.
- **R Code**: Implementation for verification and practice.
- **Deep Understanding**: Advanced statistical insights and theoretical context.
